verdict.rationale: Gusto's official MCP server lets an AI assistant query and analyze a user's own Gusto data via natural language (gusto-contest-52-1), and the agent CLI ships a 'cash-forecasting' skill that projects payroll cash needs (gusto-contest-61-5) — both give AI-derived insight from Gusto data. However, these are external agent/developer integrations rather than a native in-product AI insights/suggestions feature surfaced inside the Gusto app itself. Missing for 10: evidence of an embedded, in-app AI assistant or dashboard proactively surfacing insights/suggestions to end users, and independent confirmation of the insight quality.
